stories.title: Scheffler's 'dream' 61 ties course mark in Memphis
stories.summary: Scottie Scheffler birdied the first five holes and shot a 9-under 61 on Friday to take a three-stroke lead in the FedEx St. Jude Championship.

stories.title: Ex-Knick Oakley's assault case vs. MSG dismissed
stories.summary: A judge on Friday ruled that former Knicks All-Star Charles Oakley "produced no evidence to support his claim that he was assaulted by MSG security guards."

stories.title: Tua 'frustrated' by play in Falcons' preseason loss
stories.summary: Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa said he was "frustrated and disappointed" after Friday night's preseason loss to the Broncos, during which he played two series and was 3-of-5 passing for 22 yards.

stories.title: Vlad Jr. evaluated for concussion following collision
stories.summary: Six-time All-Star Vladimir Guerrero Jr. left the Toronto Blue Jays' 3-1 victory over the Yankees on Friday night and was evaluated for a concussion after colliding with New York rookie shortstop George Lombard Jr. on a chaotic play at third base.

stories.title: Seahawks cite positive reviews in adding Arnold
stories.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said one factor in the team's decision to offer Terrion Arnold a contract despite the felony charges he's facing was the "overwhelmingly positive" reviews they heard while vetting the free agent cornerback.
